name: 登記とりよせ
tagline: Walks you through ordering a Japanese company registry certificate
description: A Japanese-language walkthrough for requesting a company's full historical registration record through the Kantan Touki online service. It guides you from filling in the application to settling the fee by Pay-easy and then waiting on delivery by post. You keep control of your own login and banking throughout.
author: sat0xshi
